name: testloop
description: Evidence-driven ASP.NET Core API testing, diagnosis, repair, review, and retesting.

interface.longDescription: Discover, analyze, plan, execute, diagnose, repair, independently review, and retest controller-based ASP.NET Core Web APIs without inventing fixtures or weakening security.
defaultPrompt: Use TestLoop to discover and analyze this ASP.NET Core API without changing source code.
Use TestLoop in standard mode with verified fixtures and preserve all evidence.
